title: Module 3: Collections & Exceptions
description: Learn error handling, Generics, and the Java Collections Framework.

lessons.title: Exceptions, Generics, Lists, Maps, and Sorting

exercises.title: Map vs Set
exercises.instructionMarkdown: Which interface represents a collection that contains no duplicate elements and does not associate keys with values?

exercises.title: Count Unique Words
exercises.instructionMarkdown: Write a function `countUnique` that takes an array of strings and returns the number of distinct words.
hints: Add all array elements to a Set.
Return the size of the Set.

exercises.title: Debug: Array Bounds
exercises.instructionMarkdown: Fix the catch block to correctly identify and suppress the out-of-bounds error so 'Done' is printed.
hints: Check which exception is actually being thrown by `arr[5]`.
